name: yue_speech_benchmark_new
description: A Cantonese (Yue) speech benchmark for evaluating automatic speech recognition systems on Yue-language audio. It contains speech–text pairs intended to measure ASR performance on dialectal/colloquial Yue speech and related acoustic variability. The benchmark is targeted at improving and comparing models' word recognition accuracy on Yue.
reputation: A niche dataset for Cantonese/Yue ASR with limited but growing adoption among speech researchers focusing on Chinese dialects.
